privacidad.texto:
WHO WE ARE
NGS MedSpa, in Dallas – Fort Worth, Texas, offers aesthetic treatments. This policy explains what information we collect on this website and at the clinic, and how we protect it.

WHAT INFORMATION WE COLLECT
- Contact details: name, phone, email.
- Appointment details: treatment, date and any messages you leave us.
- At the clinic: your medical history, clinical photos (only with your authorization) and signed consents.

HOW WE USE IT
- To book, confirm and remind you of your appointments.
- To treat you safely and keep your records.
- To let you know when your touch-ups are due, if you agree.

HEALTH INFORMATION (HIPAA)
Your health information is protected under HIPAA. You can request our Notice of Privacy Practices at the clinic.

WHO WE SHARE IT WITH
We don't sell your information. We only share it with providers that help us operate (website hosting, secure storage) and when required by law.

YOUR RIGHTS
- Request a copy of your information or correct it.
- Withdraw your photo authorization at any time, in writing.
- Ask us to stop contacting you.

CONTACT
For any questions about your privacy, message or call us.

terminos.texto:
BOOKINGS

CANCELLATIONS

consentimientos.texto:
BEFORE EACH TREATMENT
At the clinic you'll sign, on a tablet, the informed consent for the treatment you're about to receive. It explains the risks, aftercare and contraindications, and you can ask as many questions as you like.

WHAT YOU'LL SIGN
- General consent and privacy notice (first visit).
- Botulinum toxin (Botox, Dysport).
- Fillers and biostimulators.
- Photo release (voluntary).

YOUR COPY
Each consent is stored as a locked document with your signature and the date. If you'd like a copy, ask at the clinic.
